name: Mastra
summary: Mastra is a TypeScript framework for AI agents and applications. It combines agents, a graph-based workflow engine with suspend and resume, memory, RAG, evals and observability, and can run inside React, Next.js or Node apps or as a standalone server. The company also sells a managed platform.
facts: Apache-2.0 core; ee/ directories under Mastra Enterprise License
Consumes MCP tools and can author MCP servers
goodFor: TypeScript teams building agents into web apps
Mixing free-form agents with explicit workflows
Human-in-the-loop flows that pause and resume
watchOut: Some enterprise features (e.g. RBAC, SSO) need a paid license
